critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck hump primitive along its longitudinal axis to increase total length by 40%. Simultaneously, apply a non-uniform scale of 1.5x on the vertical (Z) axis and a 0.8x scale on the transverse (Y) axis to transform the bulbous dome into an elongated, aerodynamic taper. Finally, shift the base position forward by 10% of its length to ensure it merges seamlessly with the front fuselage volume rather than appearing as a separate object.

discrepancies.observed: A short, rounded hump that ends quickly behind the cockpit.
discrepancies.reference: An elongated upper deck that extends significantly further back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The hump is relatively low and blends into the main fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: A prominent, high-profile double-decker section that rises sharply from the nose.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical height of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.reference: A more elongated, aerodynamic taper transitioning into the main fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: stretch and flatten the curve of the hump geometry

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears as a separate rounded object on top of the nose.
discrepancies.reference: An integrated structural extension that forms part of the forward fuselage volume.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: merge or align the base of the hump primitive with the front fuselage geometry
